code:
import zlib
import json

WINDOW = 4096
RESERVE = 512


def est_token(text):
    cjk = sum(1 for ch in text if '\u4e00' <= ch <= '\u9fff')
    words = len([w for w in text.replace(',', ' ').split() if w.isascii() and w.isalnum()])
    return int(round(cjk * 1.0 + words * 1.3))


def fingerprint(text):
    return zlib.crc32(text.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFFF


SYSTEM = "你是严谨的技术助理，只依据给定资料回答，资料中没有的信息要明确说明不知道。"
QUERY = "RAG 中 chunk 重叠多少比较合适？"

FRAGS = [
    "chunk 重叠通常取 chunk 长度的 10%~20%，可以在边界处保留语义连续性。",
    "重叠过大导致存储与检索成本上升，且重复内容会挤压上下文预算。",
    "chunk 重叠通常取 chunk 长度的 10%~20%，可以在边界处保留语义连续性。",  # 重复
    "向量检索的 top-k 一般取 3~10，再配合重排序模型提升精度。",
    "如果文档本身有清晰的小节标题，优先按语义边界切分而不是按固定长度。",
]

# 1) 去重
seen = set()
uniq = []
for f in FRAGS:
    fp = fingerprint(f)
    if fp in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(fp)
    uniq.append(f)

# 2) 打分排序（用与查询的词袋重合度，确定性）
def overlap(a, b):
    sa = set(c for c in a if '\u4e00' <= c <= '\u9fff')
    sb = set(c for c in b if '\u4e00' <= c <= '\u9fff')
    return len(sa & sb) / len(sa | sb) if (sa | sb) else 0.0

ranked = sorted(uniq, key=lambda f: -overlap(QUERY, f))

# 3) 按预算装箱
usable = WINDOW - RESERVE
used = est_token(SYSTEM) + est_token(QUERY)
kept = []
dropped = []
for f in ranked:
    t = est_token(f)
    if used + t <= usable:
        kept.append(f)
        used += t
    else:
        dropped.append(f)

print("窗口 %d | 预留 %d | 可用 %d" % (WINDOW, RESERVE, usable))
print("检索片段 %d 个 -> 去重后 %d 个" % (len(FRAGS), len(uniq)))
print("重复被剔除 %d 个" % (len(FRAGS) - len(uniq)))
print()
print("最终保留 %d 段，丢弃 %d 段" % (len(kept), len(dropped)))
print("已用 token %d / %d，余量 %d" % (used, usable, usable - used))
print()
print("组装后的上下文骨架:")
print("  [system]  %s" % SYSTEM[:20])
for i, f in enumerate(kept, 1):
    print("  [doc%d]    %s" % (i, f[:24]))
print("  [query]   %s" % QUERY)
print()
ok = used <= usable and len(set(fingerprint(f) for f in kept)) == len(kept)
print("预算合规 = %s | 无重复 = %s" % (used <= usable, len(kept) == len(set(fingerprint(f) for f in kept))))
print("总体校验 = %s" % ok)
